newsitem.title: USA: Lear names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Lear names chief financial officer.

text.p: Lear Corp said Thursday it named Donald Stebbins as senior vice president, chief financial officer and treasurer.
Stebbins, who had been vice president, treasurer and assistant secretary, replaces James Vandenberghe, who was executive vice president and chief financial officer.

Vandenberghe was named president and chief operating officer - North American operations, a new position. In addition, Robert Rossiter, president and chief operating officer of Lear, was named to the new post of president and chief operating officer - international operations.

Lear said the new positions for Rossiter and Vandenberghe reflect the company's efforts to build upon its global presence, capitalize on growth opportunities in North American and international markets, and bring renewed focus to its European market and customer base.

"Lear's top priority is global growth, and having our number two executive in Europe focused on international operations is a big plus for Lear," Kennethy Way, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement, referring to Rossiter.
In his new position, Vandenberghe will be responsible for Lear's North American operations and will retain overall responsibility for the financial direction of the corporation.
Lear is an automotive supplier with 1996 sales of more than $6.2 billion. The company has more than 140 facilities in 22 countries.
